title: A timeline on a whiteboard, not a verdict.

title: Organize the notes. No finding.
kit: Copilot may turn notes into a timeline and open questions. It never writes a finding, blames a person or recommends an action. Use roles, never names.

title: Ask, then see the rows.

title: Check against the control total.
kit: A control total is a checked figure from the system of record. Compare two figures with it before any number goes in a report.
…next to the control total. If they differ, find the rows.
Too high: look for duplicates. Too low: look for a missing value.
